column2: Confirm your mode of financing (i.e., cash, CPF savings, and/ or a housing loan) for your flat purchase in My Flat Dashboard.

You must submit a Request for Value for the flat if you are using your CPF savings and/ or taking up a housing loan to finance your flat purchase. You may submit the request via My Flat Dashboard after the flat sellers have granted you the OTP. Once you have made the request, you can log in to My Flat Dashboard to view the progress and outcome.
